deny.condition: Any required module returns a valid explicit REJECT
deny.reason: Biometric verification failed in at least one module.

conditions: Any required module has an error
Any required module has status not_run
Any required module returns invalid or incomplete evidence
additional_verification.reason: Complete and valid biometric evidence is not available.

allow.condition: All four required modules completed successfully and returned ACCEPT with valid evidence
allow.reason: All required biometric verification checks passed.

security_principles: Explicit rejection overrides acceptance from other modules.
Missing evidence must never be treated as acceptance.
Module errors must never silently result in ALLOW.
ALLOW requires successful evidence from all four modules.
The central engine makes the final decision.
limitations: Initial prototype policy; not production security validation.
Threshold calibration and broader biometric testing remain necessary.
Policy may need revision after M1 and M4 implementations are integrated.
